parameters.anti_windup_method: conditional integration (integrator frozen while the output is held by a limit and the error pushes deeper)

tuning.feasibility_rule: zero outlet_violation_steps, inlet_over_max_steps, inlet_under_min_steps and pue_over_max_steps in every validation episode
tuning.objective: highest mean total_reward over the validation scenarios (the PPO objective), among envelope-feasible candidates

result.tie_break: lexicographic ascending on (target_inlet_C, kp, ki, kd)
